description: This file defines the Zend_Loader class, which provides static methods for loading PHP classes and files within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for class autoloading, file inclusion, security checks, and handling include paths.

classes.name: Zend_Loader
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for class and file loading, autoload registration, and security checks within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class or interface from a PHP file, searching specified directories or using naming conventions.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Includes a PHP file, searching in specified directories or the include_path, with optional include_once behavior.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if a file is readable, considering include_path and platform-specific path formats.

methods.name: explodeIncludePath
methods.description: Splits an include_path string into an array of individual paths, handling stream schemas.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Deprecated autoload method compatible with spl_autoload(), triggers a warning.

methods.name: registerAutoload
methods.description: Registers or unregisters the autoload method with spl_autoload(), using Zend_Loader_Autoloader.

methods.name: _securityCheck
methods.description: Performs security validation on filenames to prevent exploits.

methods.name: _includeFile
methods.description: Includes a PHP file, optionally using include_once, marked as deprecated.
